metas.name: Army of Shadows
metas.description:
Resistance, in 1942 France, is cold, lonely procedure. Safe houses, coded phrases, informers executed badly — no glamour and almost no hope, filmed like a heist movie in mourning.

An account of underground resistance fighters in Nazi-occupied France.

metas.name: Paths of Glory
metas.description:
Military honour is used to cover a command failure. After a suicidal attack fails, three soldiers are chosen to be executed for cowardice to make the point, and their colonel tries law against arithmetic.

A colonel defends three of his soldiers in a court-martial after they abandon a suicidal attack.

metas.name: Microcosmos
metas.description:
At insect scale, a meadow becomes an alien world. One day in a French field, almost no narration: snails mating, a dung beetle rolling its ball uphill, rain arriving like artillery.

A documentary on insect life in meadows and ponds.

metas.name: Koyaanisqatsi
metas.description:
Civilisation itself becomes pattern. No dialogue or characters: time-lapse clouds, highways, factories, demolition and crowds cut to Philip Glass, until modern life starts to look like weather.

A collection of expertly photographed phenomena with no conventional plot. The footage focuses on the relationship between nature, humanity, and technology.

metas.name: Leviathan
metas.description:
Commercial fishing becomes a sensory ordeal. Cameras strapped to nets, chains, helmets and the hull of a North Atlantic trawler — fish heads, gulls, diesel, men half-asleep at 3 a.m., no explanation offered.

A documentary shot in the North Atlantic and focused on the commercial fishing industry.

metas.name: Apollo 13
metas.description:
Competence under constraint is the drama here. An explosion in space, and the film becomes people in rooms with slide rules solving the next physical problem before the air runs out — the opposite of lone-hero cinema.

NASA must devise a strategy to return Apollo 13 to Earth safely after the spacecraft undergoes massive internal damage putting the lives of the three astronauts on board in jeopardy.

metas.name: First Man
metas.description:
The Moon landing is seen from inside a grieving, taciturn man. Armstrong as an engineer who can land anything except in his own family's pain; the flights are rattling, cramped and procedural.

A look back at the life of astronaut Neil Armstrong and the legendary space mission that led him to become the first man to walk on the Moon on July 20, 1969.

metas.name: Princess Mononoke
metas.description:
An ecological war plays out with no pure side. Iron Town needs the forest cut to survive; the forest gods need the humans gone; a prince cursed by a dying god tries to see with unclouded eyes.

After a deadly curse forces him from home, young warrior Ashitaka journeys west and is drawn into a conflict between ancient forest spirits, an iron town, and a wolf-raised girl.

metas.name: Senna
metas.description:
Speed, faith and charisma — entirely from archive. Ayrton Senna's career built only from period footage and voices — rivalry with Prost, Brazil on his helmet, in-car laps that feel like prayer at 300 km/h.

A documentary on Brazilian Formula One racing driver Ayrton Senna, who won the F1 world championship three times before his death at age 34.

metas.name: Free Solo
metas.description:
Alex Honnold's relationship to fear is simply different from yours. He prepares to climb El Capitan without ropes while the filmmakers — his friends — argue on camera about whether filming changes the odds.

Alex Honnold faces the biggest challenge of his career, climbing El Capitan in Yosemite National Park. He pursues it Free Solo, which means climbing without a rope and alone.

metas.name: When We Were Kings
metas.description:
Ali appears here as a political and verbal artist at his peak. The Rumble in the Jungle, Zaire 1974: training footage, a music festival, Mobutu's stadium, and Ali talking everyone, including himself, into belief.

Boxing documentary on the 1974 world heavyweight championship bout between defending champion, George Foreman, and the underdog challenger, Muhammad Ali.

metas.name: The Wrestler
metas.description:
His body only has value inside the ring. An ageing, hearing-damaged wrestler on supermarket shifts, trying with his daughter, and finding the crowd is the one place the world still makes sense to him.

A faded professional wrestler must retire, but finds his quest for a new life outside the ring a dispiriting struggle.

metas.name: Raging Bull
metas.description:
Self-destruction plays out in a family kitchen as much as in a ring. Jake LaMotta's jealousy and violence at home filmed with the same intensity as the fights; he can take any punch except accountability.

The life of boxer Jake LaMotta, whose violence and temper that led him to the top in the ring destroyed his life outside of it.

metas.name: Jiro Dreams of Sushi
metas.description:
Mastery is repetition across a lifetime. An 85-year-old with a tiny Tokyo subway sushi counter and three Michelin stars, sons waiting to inherit, and a standard of 'delicious' he says he still hasn't reached.

A documentary on 85-year-old sushi master Jiro Ono, his renowned Tokyo restaurant, and his relationship with his son and eventual heir, Yoshikazu.

metas.name: The 400 Blows
metas.description:
A boy is processed, step by step, into a delinquent. Paris, a cramped flat, a teacher, small lies compounding into reform school — and a final run to the sea in one long take, ending on his face.

A young boy, left without attention, delves into a life of petty crime.

metas.name: Kes
metas.description:
A working-class kid has exactly one thing of his own. In Barnsley coal country, Billy is written off at home and school, teaches himself falconry from a library book, and a kestrel makes him articulate and gentle.

A working-class English boy spends his free time caring for and training his pet kestrel.

metas.name: Fish Tank
metas.description:
A teenage girl's anger and wanting have no room in the place she lives. An Essex estate, a 15-year-old who dances alone in empty flats, and her mum's new boyfriend who seems to actually see her.

Everything changes for 15-year-old Mia when her mum brings home a new boyfriend.

metas.name: Eighth Grade
metas.description:
Social anxiety in the age of front-facing cameras, rendered exactly. A girl filming confident advice videos she cannot follow, pool parties endured minute by minute, and a father scene near the end that rearranges parents.

An introverted teenage girl tries to survive the last week of her disastrous eighth grade year before leaving to start high school.

metas.name: Pan's Labyrinth
metas.description:
For a child in 1944 Spain, fantasy is the only available resistance. A girl with a fascist stepfather descends to a faun's tasks while the adult war continues above ground, and fantasy is never 'just' escape.

In 1944 Francoist Spain, an imaginative young girl meets a faun who tells her she's a princess and that she must prove her worthiness by completing three dangerous tasks.

metas.name: The Night of the Hunter
metas.description:
Childhood danger takes the shape of a fairy tale. A preacher with LOVE and HATE tattooed on his knuckles hunts two children down a river for hidden money; they flee by boat through a dreamlike, animal-watched night.

A self-proclaimed preacher marries a gullible widow whose young children are reluctant to tell him where their real dad hid the $10,000 he'd stolen in a robbery.

metas.name: All the President's Men
metas.description:
Journalism here is shoe leather. Watergate as phone calls, parking garages, notebooks and editors asking 'what else do you have?' — verification repeated until a presidency moves.

"The Washington Post" reporters Bob Woodward and Carl Bernstein uncover the details of the Watergate scandal that leads to President Richard Nixon's resignation.

metas.name: Spotlight
metas.description:
An investigation becomes a team slowly realising the size of the room they're in. Boston Globe reporters, church abuse, sealed records, survivors telling it plainly — no heroics beyond persistence.

The true story of how the Boston Globe uncovered the massive scandal of child molestation and cover-up within the local Catholic Archdiocese, shaking the entire Catholic Church to its core.

metas.name: The Insider
metas.description:
Telling the truth, inside two corporations at once, comes at a cost. A tobacco scientist bound by confidentiality, a TV producer with a network to protect, and an interview everyone with money wants buried.

A research chemist comes under personal and professional attack when he decides to appear in a 60 Minutes exposé on Big Tobacco.

metas.name: Zodiac
metas.description:
Obsession gathers around a case that will not close. San Francisco, years of codes, files, basements and false certainties; the killer fades and the men who chased him are what's left damaged.

Between 1968 and 1983, a San Francisco cartoonist becomes an amateur detective obsessed with tracking down the Zodiac Killer, an unidentified individual who terrorizes Northern California with a killing spree.

metas.name: Sicario
metas.description:
An idealist is used as a legal fig leaf. An FBI agent attached to a border operation she is not briefed on, a convoy into Juárez filmed like an occupying army, rules revealed only after she has broken them.

An FBI agent joins a covert DoD task force targeting a Mexican cartel. Operating outside legal boundaries with a CIA handler and a mysterious fixer, she discovers the mission's true purpose goes far beyond what she was told.

metas.name: Burning
metas.description:
Class envy curdles into a mystery with no floor. In Seoul, a delivery kid, a girl who mimes eating a tangerine so well you see it, a rich man who burns abandoned greenhouses — and a disappearance the film will not solve.

Jong-su bumps into a girl who used to live in the same neighborhood, who asks him to look after her cat while she's on a trip to Africa. When back, she introduces Ben, a mysterious guy she met there, who confesses his secret hobby.

metas.name: The Apartment
metas.description:
Loneliness inside a big company — and kindness as a decision. An insurance clerk lends his flat to executives for their affairs to get promoted, loves the elevator girl from afar, and hits Christmas at the lowest point of both.

A Manhattan insurance clerk tries to rise in his company by letting its executives use his apartment for trysts, but office politics and his own romantic hopes complicate matters.

metas.name: Amélie
metas.description:
A lonely young woman engineers small happinesses for strangers. Montmartre, a tin of childhood treasures returned to its owner, and a heroine who can fix everyone's life except ask for anything in her own.

Despite being caught in her imaginative world, young waitress Amelie decides to help people find happiness. Her quest to spread joy leads her on a journey during which she finds true love.

metas.name: Singin' in the Rain
metas.description:
Pure performed joy, inside a story about an industry panicking. Hollywood switching to sound, a star with a terrible voice, and musical numbers that still feel like showing off for the love of it.

When Hollywood's silent era gives way to talkies, a dashing screen idol and a gifted newcomer navigate romance, rivalry, and the comic chaos of reinventing the movies.

metas.name: Paddington 2
metas.description:
Decency turns out to be contagious. A bear framed for stealing the pop-up book he wanted to buy his aunt, sent to prison — and the prison improves because he is in it.

Paddington, now happily settled with the Brown family and a popular member of the local community, picks up a series of odd jobs to buy the perfect present for his Aunt Lucy's 100th birthday, only for the gift to be stolen.

metas.name: Big Night
metas.description:
Two brothers argue over whether a meal should be art or business. Italian immigrants, a failing restaurant, one elaborate dinner to save it, and a final wordless scene of one cooking breakfast for the other.

New Jersey, 1950s. Two brothers run an Italian restaurant. Business is not going well as a rival Italian restaurant is out-competing them. In a final effort to save the restaurant, the brothers plan to put on an evening of incredi...

metas.name: Rushmore
metas.description:
A precocious teenager's grandiosity is a grief strategy. A scholarship kid who runs every club and stages huge plays falls for a widowed teacher and goes to war with a sad industrialist who is, emotionally, the same age.

A teenager at Rushmore Academy falls for a much older teacher and befriends a middle-aged industrialist. Later, he finds out that his love interest and his friend are having an affair, which prompts him to begin a vendetta.

metas.name: Man with a Movie Camera
metas.description:
A city invents cinema while cinema invents the city. A Soviet day from waking to work to leisure, no story, and editing tricks in every minute that films still use — nearly a century old and showing off.

A man travels around a city with a camera slung over his shoulder, documenting urban life with dazzling invention.

metas.name: Sans Soleil
metas.description:
Memory is footage you keep re-narrating. A woman reads a travelling cameraman's letters over images of Tokyo, Guinea-Bissau, Iceland and San Francisco, until a travel film becomes a film about how a mind stores the world.

A woman narrates the contemplative writings of a seasoned world traveler, focusing on contemporary Japan.

metas.name: Los Angeles Plays Itself
metas.description:
A city is seen through the lies movies told about it. A video essay built entirely from clips — how Los Angeles is used as backdrop, villain and stand-in for everywhere else — narrated by a resident who loves it and resents all of it.

A documentary on how Los Angeles has been used and depicted in the movies.

metas.name: Close-Up
metas.description:
A poor film fan wanted, briefly, to be the man whose name he borrowed. In Tehran a man impersonates a famous director to a family, is arrested, and then everyone involved re-enacts their own case, including the trial.

The true story of Hossain Sabzian, a cinephile who impersonated the director Mohsen Makhmalbaf to convince a family they would star in his so-called new film.

metas.name: Day for Night
metas.description:
A film set becomes a chaotic temporary family. Truffaut plays the director of a mediocre melodrama, keeping affairs, breakdowns, accidents and deadlines moving toward a finished film nobody thinks is great and everybody needs.

A committed film director struggles to complete his movie while coping with a myriad of crises, personal and professional, among the cast and crew.

metas.name: News from Home
metas.description:
Emigration is long shots and your mother's voice. New York — subways, diners, empty streets — while her mother's letters from Brussels, full of family news and worry, are read over it; homesickness with the geography reversed.

Impersonal and beautiful images of Akerman's life in New York are combined with letters from her loving but manipulative mother, read by Akerman herself.

metas.name: Silence
metas.description:
Faith is tested by other people's suffering, not your own. Jesuit priests in 17th-century Japan, where Christians are tortured to make them apostatise and God does not answer — Scorsese's quietest, most unresolved film.

In the 17th century, two Portuguese Jesuit priests travel to Japan in an attempt to locate their mentor, who is rumored to have committed apostasy, and to propagate Catholicism.

metas.name: Ordet
metas.description:
A household of different faiths waits on a miracle nobody respectable believes in. A Danish farm: a strict father, a son who thinks he is Jesus, a beloved daughter-in-law — very slow and plain, then an ending argued about for 70 years.

A devout Danish family wrestle with their inner demons while also negotiating conflict with each other and the rest of the town.

metas.name: Winter Light
metas.description:
A pastor performs comfort he cannot feel. A small Swedish church, a fisherman terrified of nuclear war, a woman who has read the priest's coldness exactly — an hour and twenty minutes of winter afternoon.

A small-town priest struggles with his faith.

metas.name: First Reformed
metas.description:
Despair finds a political shape inside a small church. A minister keeping a diary in a historic church that is mostly a gift shop, and a young activist asking whether God can forgive us for what we've done to the world.

A minister of a small congregation in upstate New York grapples with mounting despair brought on by tragedy, worldly concerns and a tormented past.

metas.name: Oslo, August 31st
metas.description:
A man on leave from rehab spends a day visiting his own life. Job interview, old friends, a party, the family home for sale — Oslo in late summer light, conversations so ordinary they are painful for what he hears in them.

One day in the life of Anders, a young recovering drug addict, who takes a brief leave from his treatment center to interview for a job and catch up with old friends in Oslo.

metas.name: Trainspotting
metas.description:
The heroin scene's energy comes first; the bill arrives later. Edinburgh friends filmed like they're in the best movie ever, which is how it felt — until a baby, a toilet and a series of betrayals change the genre under them.

Renton, deeply immersed in the Edinburgh drug scene, tries to clean up and get out despite the allure of drugs and the influence of friends.

metas.name: Weekend
metas.description:
This is intimacy with an expiration date already on it. Two men meet in Nottingham on a Friday, one leaving the country on Sunday, and talk in bed, pubs and trains about sex, coming out, and how much of yourself you perform.

After a drunken house party with his straight mates, Russell heads out to a gay club. Just before closing time he picks up Glen but what's expected to be just a one-night stand becomes something else, something special.

metas.name: God's Own Country
metas.description:
Tenderness arrives, for a man who can only express feeling through work and drink, through lambing. A young Yorkshire farmer, mud and silence, and a Romanian migrant worker hired for the season who is gentle in a way he has no defences for.

Spring. Yorkshire. Young farmer Johnny Saxby numbs his daily frustrations with binge drinking and casual sex, until the arrival of a Romanian migrant worker for lambing season ignites an intense relationship that sets Johnny on a ...

metas.name: Brokeback Mountain
metas.description:
Some love affairs are conducted in a few weeks a year, across twenty years. Wyoming herders, marriages and children in between, and a shirt kept in a closet doing more work than any speech.

Two shepherds fall for each other, but their relationship becomes complicated when they both get married to their respective girlfriends.

metas.name: Taste of Cherry
metas.description:
Ordinary conversation is held, throughout, against a decision to die. A man drives the hills outside Tehran offering money to whoever will bury him in the morning, picking up a soldier, a seminarian and a taxidermist who each answer differently; the ending breaks the film open on purpose.

An Iranian man drives his car in search of someone who will quietly bury him under a cherry tree after he commits suicide.

metas.name: Under the Skin
metas.description:
Human beings, seen from outside the species, look like this. A woman drives a van around Glasgow picking up men, in real streets with hidden cameras and non-actors, and something in the routine begins to fail — images that lodge permanently.

A mysterious young woman seduces lonely men in the evening hours in Scotland. However, events lead her to begin a process of self-discovery.

metas.name: Her
metas.description:
Loneliness persists even in a warm, well-designed future. A divorced man who writes other people's love letters for a living falls for a voice in his ear, and the film takes the relationship seriously enough to let it outgrow him.

In the near future, a lonely writer develops an unlikely relationship with an operating system designed to meet his every need.

metas.name: Gattaca
metas.description:
A blood sample is enough to assign your caste here. A man born without genetic screening borrows another man's blood, urine and identity to reach space, while his 'valid' brother keeps challenging him to swimming races neither should survive.

Vincent, an "In-Valid," assumes the identity of a member of the genetic elite to pursue his goal of traveling into space with the Gattaca Aerospace Corporation. However, a week before his mission, a murder marks Vincent as a suspect.

metas.name: The Truman Show
metas.description:
His paranoia turns out to be an accurate description of his life. An insurance salesman in a seaside town so pleasant it feels laminated, a sky that malfunctions, and a dawning suspicion about everyone who loves him.

An insurance salesman begins to suspect that his whole life is actually some sort of reality TV show.

metas.name: Eternal Sunshine of the Spotless Mind
metas.description:
He is trying to keep someone he is paying to forget. A couple erase each other after a breakup; inside the procedure, mid-deletion, he changes his mind and hides her in childhood memories the technicians haven't reached.

When their relationship turns sour, a couple undergoes a medical procedure to have each other erased from their memories forever.

metas.name: Solaris
metas.description:
Grief arrives in physical form, in orbit. A psychologist on a space station finds the crew haunted by visitors the planet below has made from their memories — including his dead wife, who knows she isn't her.

A psychologist is sent to a station orbiting a distant planet in order to discover what has caused the crew to go insane.

metas.name: Room
metas.description:
For one child, the entire world is eleven feet wide — and then it isn't. A mother makes a complete, loving universe for her five-year-old inside the shed where they're held; the second half, outside, is the harder adjustment for both.

A little boy is held captive in a room with his mother since his birth, so he has never known the world outside.

metas.name: Lady Bird
metas.description:
A mother and daughter love each other in a way that keeps missing. Sacramento, a girl desperate to leave for the East Coast, a mother working double shifts, fights in moving cars, and a final voicemail that reframes every argument.

A fiercely independent teenager tries to make her own way in the world while wanting to get out of her hometown of Sacramento, California, and to get away from her complicated mother and recently-unemployed father.

metas.name: All About My Mother
metas.description:
Grief, here, assembles a chosen family. After her son is killed, a Madrid nurse returns to Barcelona and gathers an actress, a nun and a trans sex worker from her past — melodrama played completely straight, and generous.

A comedy-drama about a bereaved mother, an overwrought actress, her jealous lover, and a pregnant nun.

metas.name: Make Way for Tomorrow
metas.description:
Old parents slowly become an inconvenience to distribute. In the Depression a couple lose their house and their adult children split them between households 'temporarily' — politeness does the damage, and the farewell scene is unforgettable.

An elderly couple are forced to live hundreds of miles apart when they lose their house and none of their five children will take both parents in.

metas.name: Opening Night
metas.description:
Inside a role about ageing, an actress comes apart. Rehearsing a play in which her character must accept getting older — drinking, seeing the young fan who died outside the theatre — while the production needs her functional by Thursday.

A renowned actress teeters on the edge of a breakdown as she counts down the days toward a big Broadway opening.

metas.name: All About Eve
metas.description:
Ambition arrives wearing perfect manners. A young fan insinuates herself into a Broadway star's life one helpful errand at a time; the dialogue is the sharpest ever written for this, and every adult sees the game a moment too late.

A seemingly timid but secretly ruthless ingénue insinuates herself into the lives of an aging Broadway star and her circle of theater friends.

metas.name: Tár
metas.description:
Prestige is a system one woman believes she controls. A conductor at the top of classical music — Berlin, Mahler, acolytes — and a slow accumulation of recordings, edits and allegations, filmed with the cold precision its subject would admire.

Set in the international world of Western classical music, the film centers on Lydia Tár, widely considered one of the greatest living composer-conductors and the very first female director of a major German orchestra.

metas.name: Funny Games
metas.description:
Your appetite as a viewer is the real subject, and the film refuses to feed it the usual way. Two polite young men hold a family at their holiday house; violence happens off-screen or gets rewound, and the film keeps asking why you're still watching.

Two violent young men take a mother, father, and son hostage in their vacation cabin and force them to play sadistic "games" with one another for their own amusement.

metas.name: Atanarjuat: The Fast Runner
metas.description:
An Inuit oral epic is told here by the community it belongs to. Made in Igloolik, in Inuktitut, with a largely Inuit cast and crew: a rivalry, a murder, and a naked run across the ice told for centuries.

The telling of an Inuit legend of an evil spirit causing strife in the community and one warrior's endurance and battle of its menace.

metas.name: Incendies
metas.description:
Two children learn their mother's life was a war they knew nothing about. Montreal twins, a will, two sealed letters, and a journey into a fictionalised Lebanon their mother never described — it hits like a Greek tragedy.

Twins journey to the Middle East to discover their family history and fulfill their mother's last wishes.

metas.name: Mommy
metas.description:
For this mother and son, love is indistinguishable from the emergency. In Quebec, a widow, her volatile teenage son and a shy neighbour across the street — shot in a square frame that literally widens in the one scene where life briefly works.

A widowed single mother, raising her violent son alone, finds new hope when a mysterious neighbor inserts herself into their household.

metas.name: The Sweet Hereafter
metas.description:
The worst thing has already happened to this town before the film begins. A school bus crash in small-town BC, a lawyer arriving to build a lawsuit, and grief looking for a shape that money keeps offering and failing to be.

A bus crash in a small town brings a lawyer to defend the families, but he discovers everything isn't what it seems.

metas.name: Videodrome
metas.description:
A TV signal gets inside a man's body. A sleazy Toronto cable programmer finds a pirate broadcast of torture, becomes obsessed, and his perception and flesh start reorganising around it.

A Toronto cable TV station co-owner who specializes in adult entertainment searches for the producers of a dangerous and bizarre broadcast titled "Videodrome."

metas.name: Stories We Tell
metas.description:
A family's central story turns out to have an author problem. Sarah Polley interviews her own family about her late mother; the accounts agree on the love and diverge on everything else, then the film shows you its own construction.

A film that excavates layers of myth and memory to find the elusive truth at the core of a family of storytellers.

metas.name: The Lives of Others
metas.description:
Assigned to transcribe a playwright's life, a surveillance officer is changed by what he hears. East Berlin, 1984: a Stasi captain bugs a playwright's flat, types his reports, and quietly begins to edit what the state gets to know.

In 1984 East Berlin, an agent of the secret police conducting surveillance on a writer and his lover finds himself becoming increasingly absorbed by their lives.

metas.name: Tinker Tailor Soldier Spy
metas.description:
Espionage here is tired old men in bad rooms. A mole inside British intelligence, investigated through retirement-age sadness, Christmas parties and files — almost nothing explodes; the atmosphere is the action.

In the bleak days of the Cold War, espionage veteran George Smiley is forced from semi-retirement to uncover a Soviet Agent within MI6.

metas.name: The Third Man
metas.description:
In a ruined, divided city, a friendship curdles. Postwar Vienna: a pulp writer arrives to find his friend dead and getting saintlier the less sense the story makes — zither music, sewers, and the ferris wheel speech.

Pulp novelist Holly Martins travels to shadowy, mystifying post-war Vienna only to find himself investigating the mysterious sudden death of old friend Harry Lime.

metas.name: Notorious
metas.description:
Love itself is used as an intelligence asset. A woman is recruited to marry into a Nazi circle in Rio because of who her father was, by an agent unable to say the one thing that would make it bearable.

The daughter of a convicted German spy is asked by American agents to gather information on a ring of German scientists in South America. How far will she have to go to ingratiate herself with them?

metas.name: The Spy Who Came in from the Cold
metas.description:
Cold War spycraft looks, from inside, like exhaustion and managed betrayal. A burnt agent is sent on one last operation that requires him to become genuinely washed up — the bleakest, most honest of the Le Carré films.

Instead of coming in from field work during the Cold War and taking a desk job, British intelligence agent Alec Leamas chooses to take on another assignment.

metas.name: Rififi
metas.description:
A robbery becomes manual labour. A Paris jewel heist whose centrepiece is roughly half an hour with no dialogue and no score — umbrellas, drills, plaster dust, men breathing — that every heist film since is quoting.

Four men plan a technically perfect crime, but the human element intervenes...

metas.name: The Killing
metas.description:
The plan is perfect; the telling comes in pieces that don't line up in time. A racetrack robbery replayed from each participant's angle, a suitcase of money, and an airport finale involving a small dog.

Crook Johnny Clay assembles a five-man team to plan and execute a daring racetrack robbery.

metas.name: Sexy Beast
metas.description:
This is menace arriving in a holiday villa. A retired gangster, happily fat and sunburned in Spain, and Ben Kingsley's Don Logan flying in to scream him back to London for one job — the terror is mostly conversational.

Brutal gangster Don Logan recruits "retired" safecracker Gal for one last job, but it goes badly for both of them.

metas.name: Inside Man
metas.description:
A bank robbery plays as theatre, with a purpose you have to wait for. Manhattan hostages dressed identically to the robbers, a detective and a fixer circling each other, and a heist whose real target isn't the money.

A police detective, a bank robber and a high-power broker enter high-stakes negotiations after the criminal's brilliant heist spirals into a hostage situation.

metas.name: Hell or High Water
metas.description:
Two brothers rob the bank that is taking their family's land. West Texas, foreclosed ranches and debt-relief billboards, and two ageing Rangers following them at the speed of talk — a western wearing a recession.

A divorced father and his ex-con brother plan a series of heists against the bank that's about to foreclose on their family ranch.

metas.name: Crash
metas.description:
Desire gets re-wired here through injury and machinery. After a serious collision on Toronto highways, a couple drift into a circle for whom crashes, scars and cars have become erotic — cold, deadpan and permanently controversial.

A car crash victim suddenly finds himself turned on by car accidents and becomes involved with an underground sub-culture of like-minded souls.

metas.name: Blue Is the Warmest Colour
metas.description:
First love is filmed at the resolution of skin, food and class difference. A schoolgirl in Lille and an older art student with blue hair — long scenes of eating, talking and teaching, and a breakup stretched across years of growing into different worlds.

Adèle's life is changed when she meets Emma, a young woman with blue hair, who will allow her to discover desire and to assert herself as a woman and as an adult. In front of others, Adèle grows, seeks herself, loses herself, and ...

metas.name: Secretary
metas.description:
For one specific person, kink becomes a form of self-knowledge. A young woman fresh out of hospital for self-harm takes a typing job with a demanding lawyer, in a relationship the film treats as tender rather than a diagnosis.

A timid young woman starts working for a demanding lawyer and finds a new way to deal with her self-harming urges.

metas.name: Lust, Caution
metas.description:
An espionage performance becomes the real feeling it was faking. In occupied Shanghai, a student actress is assigned to seduce a collaborationist official so he can be killed, over years of mahjong games and assignations.

During World War II era, a young woman, Wang Jiazhi, gets swept up in a dangerous game of emotional intrigue with a powerful political figure, Mr. Yee.

metas.name: In the Realm of the Senses
metas.description:
Obsession plays out with the outside world switched off. 1930s Japan, a hotel maid and her employer in a room, in a spiral based on a real case — explicit as claustrophobia, not titillation.

A fictionalized retelling of the story of Sada Abe, whose affair with her master quickly turned obsessive and sadomasochistic.

metas.name: Touki Bouki
metas.description:
Two young people dream of Paris so hard the film itself starts hallucinating. Senegal: a cowherd and a student steal and scheme toward a ship, on a motorbike with a skull mounted on it, in editing that jumps like a skipping song.

Mory, a cowherd, and Anta, a university student, try to make money in order to go to Paris and leave their boring past behind.

metas.name: Hyenas
metas.description:
A village discovers its price. A woman returns after decades, impossibly rich, offering her poor hometown a fortune for one act of 'justice' against the man who wronged her — while shops fill with goods bought on credit.

A now-rich woman returns to her poor desert hometown to propose a deal to the populace: her fortune, in exchange for the death of the man who years earlier abandoned her and left her with his child.

metas.name: Yeelen
metas.description:
This is a myth told from inside its own cosmology. Mali, Bambara legend: a son fleeing his sorcerer father across desert and village, carrying stolen sacred objects, toward a confrontation filmed as light itself.

A young man with magical powers journeys to his uncle to request help in fighting his sorcerer father.

metas.name: Timbuktu
metas.description:
Occupation is resisted here through music, football and dignity. Jihadists take a Malian town and ban singing and soccer; people comply in public, sing quietly at night, and play a match with an invisible ball.

A cattle herder and his family who reside in the dunes of Timbuktu find their quiet lives -- which are typically free of the Jihadists determined to control their faith -- abruptly disturbed.

metas.name: A Girl Walks Home Alone at Night
metas.description:
A vampire film gets rebuilt from Iranian, Western and skate-punk parts. A fictional Iranian ghost town, a chador-wearing vampire on a skateboard, a drug dealer and a cat, in long black-and-white silences between bursts of pop.

In the Iranian ghost-town Bad City, a place that reeks of death and loneliness, the townspeople are unaware they are being stalked by a lonesome vampire.

metas.name: Atlantics
metas.description:
Young men who leave by sea return in another form. Dakar construction workers, unpaid for months, take a boat toward Spain; the film stays with the women left behind, the sea at night, and a love story conducted through possession and fever.

In a popular suburb of Dakar, workers on the construction site of a futuristic tower, without pay for months, decide to leave the country by the ocean for a better future. Among them is Souleiman, the lover of Ada, promised to ano...

metas.name: Pi
metas.description:
A pattern becomes an obsession, filmed on grain. A mathematician in a tiny New York apartment with computers made of junk, a number that Wall Street and a Hasidic sect both want, and migraines rendered as drill sounds.

A paranoid mathematician searches for a key number that will unlock the universal patterns found in nature.

metas.name: Gummo
metas.description:
Boredom and poverty fill an American town's unconnected afternoons. Xenia, Ohio, after a tornado: kids sniffing, selling dead cats, taped monologues, no plot arriving to save anyone.

Lonely residents of a tornado-stricken Ohio town wander the deserted landscape trying to fulfill their boring, nihilistic lives.

metas.name: George Washington
metas.description:
Rural Southern childhood unfolds in the long light after something goes wrong. Kids in a decaying town carry an accident together, and a boy in a cape wants to be a hero — all voiceover and golden fields.

A group of children, in a depressed small town, band together to cover up a tragic mistake one summer.

metas.name: Brief Encounter
metas.description:
Their desire obeys the rules anyway. A doctor and a housewife meet in a railway station café, fall in love in weekly instalments, and give each other up — two ordinary people torn apart by behaving well.

Meeting a stranger in a railway station, a woman is tempted to cheat on her husband.

metas.name: Woman in the Dunes
metas.description:
Entrapment quietly becomes routine. A man is lowered into a sand pit to shovel beside the woman who already lives there; escape stays theoretically possible while the days quietly become a life.

An entomologist on vacation is trapped by local villagers into living with a woman whose life task is shoveling sand for them.

metas.name: The Shop on Main Street
metas.description:
This is collaboration at its smallest and most cowardly. A Slovak carpenter handed a Jewish widow's button shop under Aryanization laws hides her instead of profiting — comic and gentle, until the roundup comes anyway.

A carpenter in the Fascist Slovak State is appointed "Aryan controller" of a Jewish widow's store.

metas.name: Daisies
metas.description:
Two girls decide the world is spoiled, so they'll be spoiled too. A Czech New Wave food-fight against everything — banquets wrecked, scissors, fire, a chandelier swing — anarchy as pure visual mischief.

After realizing that all world is spoiled, Marie and Marie are committed to be spoiled themselves. They rip off older men, feast in lavish meals and do all kinds of mischief. But what is all this leading to?

metas.name: Playtime
metas.description:
Modern architecture fails, repeatedly, to be lived in. Tati wanders a Paris of glass and identical cubicles where the jokes happen at the edges of the frame, all at once, none of them underlined.

Monsieur Hulot curiously wanders around a high-tech Paris, paralleling a trip with a group of American tourists. Meanwhile, a nightclub/restaurant prepares its opening night, but it's still under construction.

metas.name: The Colour of Pomegranates
metas.description:
A poet's life is rendered as a series of icons instead of events. An Armenian troubadour rendered in tableaux — books, blood, grapes, lace — with almost no dialogue and no interest in explaining itself.

The life of the Armenian poet Sayat-Nova, from childhood to death: his spiritual journey, artistic endeavors, and inner conflicts within the cultural and historical context of Armenia. Hailed as revolutionary by Mikhail Vartanov.

metas.name: The Long Goodbye
metas.description:
Decency is out of sync with this decade. Altman's Philip Marlowe shuffles through sunlit, corrupt Los Angeles in a rumpled suit, the last person still taking loyalty seriously.

Marlowe investigates a friend's alleged suicide, missing money and murder in 1970s Los Angeles.

metas.name: The Vanishing
metas.description:
The need to know becomes a trap. Not a whodunit but a how-and-why: a man's obsession with his girlfriend's disappearance, and the ordinary, methodical man who offers him the answer at a price.

Rex and Saskia, a young couple in love, are on vacation. They stop at a busy service station and Saskia is abducted. After three years and no sign of Saskia, Rex begins receiving letters from the abductor.
